# xg2g PSI (PAT/PMT/descriptor) corpus, format version 1
#
# Generated. To change it, edit psiCorpusCases() in
# backend/internal/stream/ingest/mediafacts/psi_corpus_test.go and run
#   go test ./internal/stream/ingest/mediafacts/ -run TestPSICorpus -update-psi-corpus
#
# A case is a core constructed with a target program number, then a sequence of
# calls. Each call is followed by the PSI-scoped part of the ParseResult it must
# produce:
#
#   chunk <hex>   one Ingest of these bytes, at the offset the previous chunks reached
#   target <n>    one SetTargetProgram
#   facts ...     the scalar facts after that call, and ProcessedThroughOffset
#   track ...     one line per audio track, in the order the PMT declares them
#   events ...    the event kinds that call produced, in order
#   psi ...       the raw ActivePSI packets, named by their index in the case's
#                 own packet sequence: packet N is bytes [188N, 188N+188) of the
#                 case's chunks concatenated
#
# Chunk boundaries are part of the case: a section assembler carries a partial
# section across a call, so the same packets cut differently are a different
# input.
#
# No case carries video elementary stream payload, so no case produces a random
# access point. Video facts here are the ones the PMT alone declares.
#
# A `note` on a case marks an expectation that records what the Go reference does
# today without a decision having been taken that it is what it should do.
version 1

case pat_then_pmt_in_one_chunk
  desc the PAT names the PMT PID and the PMT names the streams; each is one identity change
  init target=1
  chunk 
  facts through=376 hasPAT=1 hasPMT=1 pmtVersion=0 programNumber=1 pmtPID=256 videoPID=257 videoCodec=h264 audioPIDs=258
  track pid=258 streamType=6 codec=ac3 lang=deu channels=2 multichannel=0 componentType=2 hasComponentType=1
  events identity identity
  psi pat=0 pmt=1
end
